lunar_events_compat.notification.baby_ho: The "Baby Horde Moon" rises... Tiny footsteps patter in the dark.
The "Baby Horde Moon" sets... The little ones run out of energy.
lunar_events_compat.notification.black_m: The "Black Moon" rises... Darkness swallows your sight.
The "Black Moon" sets... Your eyes adjust to the light.
lunar_events_compat.notification.chaos_m: The "Chaos Moon" rises... Every creature turns on every other!
The "Chaos Moon" sets... An uneasy peace returns.
lunar_events_compat.notification.ender_m: The "Ender Moon" rises... The End bleeds into the Overworld.
The "Ender Moon" sets... The void recedes.
lunar_events_compat.notification.horde_m: The "Horde Moon" rises... A rotting horde shambles out of the dark.
The "Horde Moon" sets... The horde begins to burn.
lunar_events_compat.notification.miners_: The "Miner's Moon" rises... Ores glitter and the caves grow restless.
The "Miner's Moon" sets... The veins grow dull again.
lunar_events_compat.notification.peacefu: The "Peaceful Moon" rises... The night is too bright for monsters.
The "Peaceful Moon" sets... Monsters stir once more.
lunar_events_compat.notification.spider_: The "Spider Moon" rises... Countless legs skitter in the dark.
The "Spider Moon" sets... The webs fall silent.
lunar_events_compat.notification.super_h: The "Super Horde Moon" rises... Every monster in the land answers its call!
The "Super Horde Moon" sets... The great horde scatters.
